items.note: G.O.(Ms.) No.708, Public (Misc.) Dept, dated 11-11-2025 prints 'Visuvavasu, Aippasi 25' for that day, so Aippasi began 18-10-2025 (the astronomical rule gives 17-10-2025).
G.O.(Ms.) No.708: Pongal (Thai 1) on 15-01-2026 (the astronomical rule gives 14-01-2026: Makara sankranti before sunset).

Aavani 1 = 18-08-2026. Tamil month dates follow the Vakya sankramana date, as Tamil Nadu almanacs keep them (even Thirukanitha ones: Sri Thanigai Thirukanitha Panchangam 2026-27, page 2 note); the Drik sankranti is on the 17th in the morning.

Purattasi 1 = 18-09-2026. Tamil month dates follow the Vakya sankramana date, as Tamil Nadu almanacs keep them (even Thirukanitha ones: Sri Thanigai Thirukanitha Panchangam 2026-27, page 2 note); the Drik sankranti is on the 17th in the morning.

Tradition choice: the Sri Thanigai Thirukanitha Panchangam 2026-27 keeps Saraswati / Ayudha Puja on 20-10-2026 (Navami at its time). The Tamil Nadu holiday G.O.(Ms.) No.708 has 19-10; the holiday list keeps that.
Tradition choice: Thanigai Thirukanitha Panchangam 2026-27 keeps Vijaya Dasami on 21-10-2026; the holiday G.O. has 20-10 and the holiday list keeps that.

Tradition choice: Purnima begins 6:22 PM on 21-03-2027 in Bhadra; the Dharmasindhu rule (and DoPT's Holika Dahan / Dolyatra) take the 22nd, Tamil almanacs keep Kama Dahanam on the night of the 21st (Thanigai Thirukanitha Panchangam 2026-27).
Follows Kama Dahanam on 21-03-2027: Holi 22-03 as the Thanigai Thirukanitha Panchangam 2026-27 lists it.

Tradition choice: Ekadashi lasts only 70 minutes after sunrise on 19-01-2027; the Rashtriya Panchang's Smarta rule takes the 18th, the Thanigai Thirukanitha Panchangam keeps Bhishma Ekadashi on the 19th.
